wikipedia.noteJa: 地名の記事は、エルサレムの門衛の家系にちなみ集落名が付いたと説明しますが、歴代誌9章17節の個人を特定してはいません。
wikipedia.locator: Lead and History, lines 119–143: the page is about a modern settlement and says its name derives from a Jerusalem gatekeeper family who returned in Nehemiah’s time. It does not identify the specific individual Talmon listed with the gatekeepers in 1 Chronicles 9:17.
